repo_prior_art.cite: none; the Stat catalogue has no rare-event PN/PS honest-inference frontier, and scm_mediator_monotonicity_pn_v1 is a distinct mediator partial-ID kernel.

published_prior_art.cite: TianWu2025 gives regular efficient PN/PS inference; CuellarKennedy2020 gives regular projected-PC inference; ZhangWangMiao2025 gives inference for generally partially identified PN bounds, not a point-identified rare-count PN likelihood-ratio frontier.
TianWu2025 derives the monotone-PN efficient influence function and regular large-sample theory; the triangular-array endpoint is a close extension.
GleserHwang1987 supplies the finite-expected-diameter impossibility template; the bounded monotone-PN two-point specialization is not stated there.

Huwang1995 establishes nonuniform coverage failure for a normal-approximation binomial interval; the rare score-cell Poisson limit is a standard rare-multinomial specialization once the PN submodel is fixed.
HannartNaveau2018 and KirilioukNaveau2020 address climate probabilities of causation and event choices, but do not give selection-honest learned score-cell inference.

structure_flags.label: thm:lr-frontier
structure_flags.one_line: The strongest and open kernel is labeled a theorem; relabel the frontier and its matched lower-bound program as a conjecture until it is derived.

novelty_flags.label: related_work / thm:lr-frontier
novelty_flags.one_line: The survey omits CuellarKennedy2020 and the public-theorem preprint ZhangWangMiao2025, both substantially closer PN-inference comparators that must be explicitly separated from the rare point-identified target.

novelty_flags.label: MikushevaSun2022 comparison
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposal says MikushevaSun2022 motivates least-favorable test inversion, but the paper develops jackknifed Anderson--Rubin weak-IV tests and a pretest, not a least-favorable conditional likelihood-ratio inversion.

soundness_flags.label: def:conditional-experiment / def:score-cell-lr-inversion
soundness_flags.one_line: After conditioning on W_n, which fixes two cell indicators, L_n(P;C) cannot remain the displayed unconditional four-cell product likelihood; the actual conditional law of R_n, its normalization, and the jointly valid cross-fold conditioning sigma-field are unspecified.

soundness_flags.label: thm:lan
soundness_flags.one_line: ass:transition-compatibility is identically vacuous when n d_n<=log n, yet thm:lan covers every n d_n→∞ sequence, including n d_n=o(log n); impose a rare-scale remainder condition for that regime or restrict LAN.

soundness_flags.label: lem:lf-membership
soundness_flags.one_line: Its listed constant and Hölder-radius conditions do not ensure ass:transition-compatibility for P_n^{LF}; for small smoothness relative to p the displayed sqrt(n/d_n)r_{e,n}r_{0,n} term need not vanish, so membership needs that premise.

soundness_flags.label: ass:transition-compatibility
soundness_flags.one_line: This load-bearing nonstandard rate restriction is justified only as an instrumental spline calculation, not by a credible condition under which the climate or stroke applications satisfy it; establish attainability or state the result under standard weaker conditions with its resulting rate.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:lower / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The lower bound uses only the certified covariate-homogeneous least-favorable submodel.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The lower rate is conditional for all measurable confidence-set procedures honest over a PN class containing that stated submodel.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the conditional-likelihood prose by an explicit conditional sample space for R_n given W_n, including its normalized Poisson-binomial likelihood, finite/sieve profiling domain, measurable least-favorable quantile, and a conditioning scheme valid jointly across folds.
Relabel thm:lr-frontier, thm:lan, thm:lower, and thm:poisson as conjectural components of one sharp-frontier conjecture, while retaining the selected-event item as an OEQ.

Add CuellarKennedy2020 and ZhangWangMiao2025, state their targets and regular regimes precisely, and sharpen the claimed novelty to the first point-identified PN/PS honest rare-count frontier under monotonicity.

Repair the transition split: certify least-favorable membership under every stated rate regime and give either a separate sub-log effective-count argument or a uniform remainder assumption covering all n d_n→∞ sequences.

recommended_next_step: Revise the conditional experiment and transition/membership conditions, correct the survey attribution, and resubmit the repaired conjectural field-tier frontier.
